# Bread Technologies, Inc.

Bread Technologies, Inc. is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Bread Technologies provides AI visibility tools and agent-readiness implementation to help businesses stay ahead in the web. Bread Technologies, Inc. employs 5 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Canada.

## About

AI systems are describing, comparing, and recommending businesses to customers in conversations that analytics don't capture. Organic search traffic is declining. AI agents are visiting websites. The way people find and evaluate businesses is changing structurally, and most companies can't see it happening.

Bread builds tools for this shift. OpenLens (tryopenlens.com), our free AI visibility tool, shows what ChatGPT, Claude, Google AI, Perplexity, and DeepSeek say about your brand when your customers ask. For agent traffic detection, site readiness, and implementation, we work directly with companies navigating the transition.

We publish what we learn at aibread.com.
